title: The failure fingerprint cuts a pytest id at a space inside its parameter brackets
goal: first_failure reads a pytest id up to its closing bracket when its parameters hold spaces, so two cases of one test that differ after the first word give two fingerprints.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import backlog as b; assert b.first_failure('FAILED t.py::f[a b] - x') != b.first_failure('FAILED t.py::f[a c] - x')
